tests.description: App starts and Swagger UI accessible
GET /vehicles → paginated list with model relation
GET /vehicles/:id (first call) → cache miss, populates Redis
GET /vehicles/:id after mutation → cache miss, re-populates
GET /vehicles (list) → populates Redis with paginated key
POST /vehicles → event published to fleet.events exchange

bugs_found_and_fixed.description: Redis port mismatch — app connected to wrong Redis instance (port 6379 = imobi_redis) instead of aivacol-fleet-redis (port 6380)
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: REDIS_PORT=6379 in .env, but aivacol-fleet-redis is mapped to host port 6380. Another project's Redis (imobi_redis) occupied port 6379.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Updated .env REDIS_PORT=6380 for local dev. Added explicit REDIS_PORT: '6379' override in docker-compose app service for Docker networking.

bugs_found_and_fixed.description: MongoDB port mismatch — app connected to wrong MongoDB (port 27017 = another project) instead of aivacol-fleet-mongodb (port 27018)
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017 in .env. Another project's MongoDB occupied port 27017.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Updated .env MONGODB_URI=mongodb://localhost:27018/fleet_audit for local dev. docker-compose already overrides to mongodb://mongodb:27017 for Docker.

bugs_found_and_fixed.description: Redis cache completely non-functional — @nestjs/cache-manager v3 API incompatibility with cache-manager-redis-yet
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: @nestjs/cache-manager v3 uses cache-manager v7 + keyv v5 architecture. The old 'store' config key was silently ignored; the module fell back to in-memory cache. No Redis keys were ever written.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Rewrote cache.module.ts to use @keyv/redis (the correct package for this stack). Used KeyvRedis adapter (default export) wrapped with CJS Keyv to pass instanceof check in @nestjs/cache-manager v3.

bugs_found_and_fixed.description: Cache list invalidation used store.keys(pattern) API that no longer exists in cache-manager v7
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: cache-manager v7 Cache type has no keys() method. The cast to access store.keys() silently caught the undefined error, making invalidations no-ops.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed invalidateListCache() to call cacheManager.clear() with noNamespaceAffectsAll: true on the KeyvRedis adapter, clearing all cached vehicle entries on mutations.

bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: NestJS default for POST handlers is 201. Login is not creating a resource.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK) to the login controller method.

known_issues.description: license_plate field has no format validation — accepts any string up to 10 chars
known_issues.note: By design per spec: no regex enforced to support both old format (ABC-1234) and Mercosul (ABC1D23)

architecture_notes.cache_key_format: keyv::keyv:{original_key} — prefix added by Keyv CJS layer + @keyv/redis separator
architecture_notes.cache_invalidation: clear() flushes entire cache on any vehicle mutation (list + detail). Acceptable for this scope.
architecture_notes.audit_pipeline: vehicle mutation → EventPublisherService.publish() (fire-and-forget) → RabbitMQ fleet.events exchange → AuditConsumer → MongoDB audit_logs
architecture_notes.seed_ids: On fresh DB: brands IDs 1-3, models IDs 1-3. seed_vehicles.json uses model_id 1/2/3. Idempotent: re-running does not create duplicates.
